audit_status.source_base: Greek Acts text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for arrest, council, name/saving-healing witness, boldness, no other name, prayer with Psalm 2, Spirit-filled speech, common possessions, Barnabas.

verses.restored: As they were speaking to the people, the priests, captain of the temple, and Sadducees came upon them,

familiar.text: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

modern.text: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to them,

original.text: Λαλούντων δὲ αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ἐπέστησαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ⸀ἱερεῖς καὶ ὁ στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ Σαδδουκαῖοι,

verses.restored: being greatly troubled because they were teaching the people and announcing in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

familiar.text: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

modern.text: greatly disturbed that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.

original.text: διαπονούμενοι διὰ τὸ διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς τὸν λαὸν καὶ καταγγέλλειν ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ τὴν ἀνάστασιν ⸂τὴν ἐκ⸃ νεκρῶν,

verses.restored: They laid hands on them and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.

familiar.text: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

modern.text: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in custody until the next day.

original.text: καὶ ἐπέβαλον αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἔθεντο εἰς τήρησιν εἰς τὴν αὔριον, ἦν γὰρ ἑσπέρα ἤδη.

verses.restored: But many of those who heard the word trusted, and the number of the men came to about five thousand.

familiar.text: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

modern.text: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.

original.text: πολλοὶ δὲ τῶν ἀκουσάντων τὸν λόγον ἐπίστευσαν, καὶ ἐγενήθη ⸀ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ⸀ὡς χιλιάδες πέντε.

verses.restored: It happened on the next day that their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered in Jerusalem,

familiar.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

modern.text: The next day the rulers, elders, and scribes assembled in Jerusalem,

original.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον συναχθῆναι αὐτῶν τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ ⸀τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ ⸁τοὺς γραμματεῖς ⸀ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ

verses.restored: with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were from the high-priestly family.

familiar.text: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

modern.text: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and many others from the high priest’s family.

original.text: (καὶ ⸂Ἅννας ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ Καϊάφας καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος⸃ καὶ ὅσοι ἦσαν ἐκ γένους ἀρχιερατικοῦ),

verses.restored: Setting them in the middle, they were inquiring, In what power or in what name did you do this?

familiar.text: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

modern.text: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”

original.text: καὶ στήσαντες αὐτοὺς ἐν ⸀τῷ μέσῳ ἐπυνθάνοντο· Ἐν ποίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ ἐν ποίῳ ὀνόματι ἐποιήσατε τοῦτο ὑμεῖς;

verses.restored: Then Peter, filled with holy Spirit, said to them, Rulers of the people and elders,

familiar.text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

modern.text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers and elders of the people!

original.text: τότε Πέτρος πλησθεὶς πνεύματος ἁγίου εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ⸀πρεσβύτεροι,

verses.restored: if we today are examined concerning a good deed to a weak human, by what this one has been saved/healed,

familiar.text: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

modern.text: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame, to determine how he was healed,

original.text: εἰ ἡμεῖς σήμερον ἀνακρινόμεθα ἐπὶ εὐεργεσίᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀσθενοῦς, ἐν τίνι οὗτος σέσωσται,

verses.restored: let it be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel that in the name of Jesus Messiah the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom the Divine raised from the dead, in this one this human stands before you whole.

familiar.text: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

modern.text: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

original.text: γνωστὸν ἔστω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου, ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐν τούτῳ οὗτος παρέστηκεν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ὑγιής.

verses.restored: This is the stone treated as nothing by you the builders, which became head of the corner.

familiar.text: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

modern.text: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’

original.text: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐξουθενηθεὶς ὑφʼ ὑμῶν τῶν ⸀οἰκοδόμων, ὁ γενόμενος εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας.

verses.restored: And there is saving/healing in no other, for there is no other name under heaven given among humans by which it is necessary for us to be saved/healed.

familiar.text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

modern.text: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.” The Name Forbidden

original.text: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἄλλῳ οὐδενὶ ἡ σωτηρία, ⸀οὐδὲ γὰρ ὄνομά ἐστιν ἕτερον ⸂ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν⸃ τὸ δεδομένον ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐν ᾧ δεῖ σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

verses.restored: Beholding the boldness of Peter and John and perceiving that they were unlettered and ordinary humans, they marveled; and they recognized them as those who had been with Jesus.

familiar.text: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

modern.text: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they marveled and took note that these men had been with Jesus.

original.text: Θεωροῦντες δὲ τὴν τοῦ Πέτρου παρρησίαν καὶ Ἰωάννου καὶ καταλαβόμενοι ὅτι ἄνθρωποι ἀγράμματοί εἰσιν καὶ ἰδιῶται, ἐθαύμαζον, ἐπεγίνωσκόν τε αὐτοὺς ὅτι σὺν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἦσαν,

verses.restored: Seeing the human who had been healed standing with them, they had nothing to say against it.

familiar.text: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

modern.text: And seeing the man who had been healed standing there with them, they had nothing to say in response.

original.text: τόν ⸀τε ἄνθρωπον βλέποντες σὺν αὐτοῖς ἑστῶτα τὸν τεθεραπευμένον οὐδὲν εἶχον ἀντειπεῖν.

verses.restored: Commanding them to go outside the council, they were conferring with one another,

familiar.text: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

modern.text: So they ordered them to leave the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.

original.text: κελεύσαντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔξω τοῦ συνεδρίου ἀπελθεῖν συνέβαλλον πρὸς ἀλλήλους

verses.restored: saying, What shall we do with these humans? For that a known sign has happened through them is manifest to all those dwelling in Jerusalem, and we are not able to deny it.

familiar.text: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

modern.text: “What shall we do with these men?” they asked. “It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them, and we cannot deny it.

original.text: λέγοντες· Τί ⸀ποιήσωμεν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις; ὅτι μὲν γὰρ γνωστὸν σημεῖον γέγονεν διʼ αὐτῶν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλὴμ φανερόν, καὶ οὐ δυνάμεθα ⸀ἀρνεῖσθαι·

verses.restored: But so that it may not spread further among the people, let us threaten them not to speak anymore in this name to any human.

familiar.text: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

modern.text: But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.”

original.text: ἀλλʼ ἵνα μὴ ἐπὶ πλεῖον διανεμηθῇ εἰς τὸν λαόν, ⸀ἀπειλησώμεθα αὐτοῖς μηκέτι λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ μηδενὶ ἀνθρώπων.

verses.restored: Calling them, they commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

familiar.text: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

modern.text: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.

original.text: καὶ καλέσαντες αὐτοὺς παρήγγειλαν ⸀τὸ καθόλου μὴ φθέγγεσθαι μηδὲ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: But Peter and John answered and said to them, Whether it is righteous before the Divine to hear you rather than the Divine, judge.

familiar.text: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

modern.text: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.

original.text: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης ἀποκριθέντες ⸂εἶπον πρὸς αὐτούς⸃· Εἰ δίκαιόν ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἀκούειν μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦ θεοῦ, κρίνατε,

verses.restored: For we are not able not to speak of what we saw and heard.

familiar.text: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

modern.text: For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.”

original.text: οὐ δυνάμεθα γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἃ εἴδαμεν καὶ ἠκούσαμεν μὴ λαλεῖν.

verses.restored: After threatening them further, they released them, finding nothing for which they might punish them, because of the people, for all were glorifying the Divine over what had happened.

familiar.text: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

modern.text: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.

original.text: οἱ δὲ προσαπειλησάμενοι ἀπέλυσαν αὐτούς, μηδὲν εὑρίσκοντες τὸ πῶς ⸀κολάσωνται αὐτούς, διὰ τὸν λαόν, ὅτι πάντες ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεὸν ἐπὶ τῷ γεγονότι·

verses.restored: For the human on whom this sign of healing had happened was more than forty years old.

familiar.text: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

modern.text: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old. The Believers’ Prayer (Psalms 2:1–12)

original.text: ἐτῶν γὰρ ἦν πλειόνων τεσσεράκοντα ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐφʼ ὃν ⸀γεγόνει τὸ σημεῖον τοῦτο τῆς ἰάσεως.

verses.restored: Having been released, they came to their own and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.

familiar.text: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

modern.text: On their release, Peter and John returned to their own people and reported everything that the chief priests and elders had said to them.

original.text: Ἀπολυθέντες δὲ ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἰδίους καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ὅσα πρὸς αὐτοὺς οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι εἶπαν.

verses.restored: Hearing, they lifted one voice to the Divine and said, Master, you who made heaven and earth and sea and all things in them,

familiar.text: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

modern.text: When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.

original.text: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἦραν φωνὴν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν καὶ εἶπαν· Δέσποτα, ⸀σὺ ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς,

verses.restored: who through holy Spirit by the mouth of our father David your servant said, Why did nations rage and peoples meditate empty things?

familiar.text: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

modern.text: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David: ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

original.text: ὁ ⸂τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν⸃ διὰ ⸂πνεύματος ἁγίου⸃ στόματος Δαυὶδ παιδός σου εἰπών· Ἱνατί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά;

verses.restored: The kings of the earth stood near, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against his Messiah.

familiar.text: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

modern.text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against His Anointed One.’

original.text: παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: For in truth, in this city, they were gathered against your holy servant/child Jesus, whom you anointed: both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with nations and peoples of Israel,

familiar.text: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

modern.text: In fact, this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.

original.text: συνήχθησαν γὰρ ἐπʼ ἀληθείας ⸂ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ⸃ ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον παῖδά σου Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ἔχρισας, Ἡρῴδης τε καὶ Πόντιος Πιλᾶτος σὺν ἔθνεσιν καὶ λαοῖς Ἰσραήλ,

verses.restored: to do whatever your hand and your purpose had predestined to happen.

familiar.text: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

modern.text: They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.

original.text: ποιῆσαι ὅσα ἡ χείρ σου καὶ ἡ ⸀βουλὴ προώρισεν γενέσθαι.

verses.restored: And now, Lord, look upon their threats and give to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

familiar.text: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

modern.text: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,

original.text: καὶ τὰ νῦν, κύριε, ἔπιδε ἐπὶ τὰς ἀπειλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ δὸς τοῖς δούλοις σου μετὰ παρρησίας πάσης λαλεῖν τὸν λόγον σου,

verses.restored: while you stretch out your hand for healing, and signs and wonders happen through the name of your holy servant/child Jesus.

familiar.text: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

modern.text: as You stretch out Your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of Your holy servant Jesus.”

original.text: ἐν τῷ τὴν χεῖρά ⸀σου ἐκτείνειν σε εἰς ἴασιν καὶ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα γίνεσθαι διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ ἁγίου παιδός σου Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: When they had prayed, the place in which they were gathered was shaken, and they were all filled with holy Spirit and were speaking the word of the Divine with boldness.

familiar.text: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

modern.text: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly. Sharing among Believers (Acts 2:42–47)

original.text: καὶ δεηθέντων αὐτῶν ἐσαλεύθη ὁ τόπος ἐν ᾧ ἦσαν συνηγμένοι, καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν ἅπαντες ⸂τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος⸃, καὶ ἐλάλουν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ μετὰ παρρησίας.

verses.restored: The multitude of those who trusted were one heart and soul/life, and not one said that anything belonging to him was his own, but all things were common to them.

familiar.text: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

modern.text: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they owned.

original.text: Τοῦ δὲ πλήθους τῶν πιστευσάντων ἦν ⸀καρδία καὶ ⸀ψυχὴ μία, καὶ οὐδὲ εἷς τι τῶν ὑπαρχόντων ⸀αὐτῷ ἔλεγεν ἴδιον εἶναι, ἀλλʼ ἦν αὐτοῖς ⸀πάντα κοινά.

verses.restored: With great power the apostles were giving witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all.

familiar.text: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

modern.text: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.

original.text: καὶ ⸂δυνάμει μεγάλῃ⸃ ἀπεδίδουν τὸ μαρτύριον οἱ ἀπόστολοι ⸂τῆς ἀναστάσεως τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ⸃, χάρις τε μεγάλη ἦν ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς.

verses.restored: For there was not anyone needy among them; as many as were owners of lands or houses were selling and bringing the proceeds of what was sold,

familiar.text: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

modern.text: There were no needy ones among them, because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property, bring the proceeds from the sales,

original.text: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐνδεής τις ⸀ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς· ὅσοι γὰρ κτήτορες χωρίων ἢ οἰκιῶν ὑπῆρχον, πωλοῦντες ἔφερον τὰς τιμὰς τῶν πιπρασκομένων

verses.restored: and laying them at the apostles' feet; it was distributed to each as anyone had need.

familiar.text: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

modern.text: and lay them at the apostles’ feet for distribution to anyone as he had need.

original.text: καὶ ἐτίθουν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων· διεδίδετο δὲ ἑκάστῳ καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν.

verses.restored: Joseph, who was called Barnabas by the apostles, which is translated Son of Encouragement, a Levite, Cypriot by birth,

familiar.text: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

modern.text: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),

original.text: ⸀Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἐπικληθεὶς Βαρναβᾶς ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον υἱὸς παρακλήσεως, Λευίτης, Κύπριος τῷ γένει,

verses.restored: having a field, sold it, brought the silver, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

familiar.text: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

modern.text: sold a field he owned, brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

original.text: ὑπάρχοντος αὐτῷ ἀγροῦ πωλήσας ἤνεγκεν τὸ χρῆμα καὶ ἔθηκεν ⸀παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων.
